# Configuration

This project is configured primarily through environment variables consumed by the processor service. The frontend enabler receives its runtime values from the processor API and from the `NuveiEnabler` constructor options supplied by the host checkout application.

## Environment variables

The processor loads environment variables with `dotenv` in `processor/src/index.ts`. When running locally, start the processor from the `processor/` directory so `processor/.env` is the loaded dotenv file. The runtime configuration is assembled in `processor/src/config/config.ts`, and the commercetools Connect deployment schema is declared in `connect.yaml`.

Do not expose `CTP_CLIENT_SECRET`, `NUVEI_SECRET_KEY`, or other credential values in documentation, logs, or browser code.

| Variable | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `CTP_PROJECT_KEY` | Required in `connect.yaml`; source default allows local startup | `payment-integration` | commercetools project key used by the SDK and permission health checks. Use the real project key for any functional environment. |
| `CTP_CLIENT_ID` | Required at runtime and in `connect.yaml` secured configuration | `xxx` | commercetools API client ID. Runtime validation rejects the fallback value. |
| `CTP_CLIENT_SECRET` | Required at runtime and in `connect.yaml` secured configuration | `xxx` | commercetools API client secret. Runtime validation rejects the fallback value. |
| `CTP_AUTH_URL` | Required at runtime and in `connect.yaml` | `https://auth.europe-west1.gcp.commercetools.com` | commercetools OAuth endpoint. Must be an HTTPS URL. |
| `CTP_API_URL` | Required at runtime and in `connect.yaml` | `https://api.europe-west1.gcp.commercetools.com` | commercetools HTTP API endpoint. Must be an HTTPS URL. |
| `CTP_SESSION_URL` | Required at runtime and in `connect.yaml` | `https://session.europe-west1.gcp.commercetools.com/` | commercetools Session API endpoint. Must be an HTTPS URL. |
| `CTP_CHECKOUT_URL` | Required at runtime and in `connect.yaml` | `https://checkout.europe-west1.gcp.commercetools.com` | commercetools Checkout API URL and the default allowed CORS origin. Must be an HTTPS URL. |
| `CTP_JWKS_URL` | Required at runtime and in `connect.yaml` | `https://mc-api.europe-west1.gcp.commercetools.com/.well-known/jwks.json` | JWKS endpoint used for JWT validation. Must be an HTTPS URL. |
| `CTP_JWT_ISSUER` | Required at runtime and in `connect.yaml` | `https://mc-api.europe-west1.gcp.commercetools.com` | Expected JWT issuer. Must be an HTTPS URL. |
| `NUVEI_ENV` | Required in `connect.yaml`; optional at runtime | `test` | Nuvei frontend environment value returned by the processor config endpoint. Valid values are `test` and `production`. |
| `NUVEI_MERCHANT_ID` | Required at runtime and in `connect.yaml` | None | Nuvei merchant identifier used for signed API calls and exposed to the frontend config response. |
| `NUVEI_MERCHANT_SITE_ID` | Required at runtime and in `connect.yaml` | None | Nuvei merchant site identifier used for signed API calls and exposed to the frontend config response. |
| `NUVEI_SECRET_KEY` | Required at runtime and in `connect.yaml` secured configuration | None | Nuvei secret key used to sign API requests and validate DMN checksums. Keep this server-side only. |
| `NUVEI_API_BASE_URL` | Required at runtime and in `connect.yaml` | None | Nuvei API base URL. Must include the `https://` scheme; `NuveiClient` appends `/api/v1` when the path does not already end with `/api/v1`. |
| `NUVEI_DMN_CHECKSUM_ALGORITHM` | Optional | `sha256` | DMN checksum algorithm. Runtime validation accepts only `sha256`. |
| `CONNECT_SERVICE_URL` | Optional at runtime; used by post-deploy script | None | Public base URL of the processor service. `processor/src/connectors/post-deploy.ts` prints `${CONNECT_SERVICE_URL}/webhooks/nuvei` as the Nuvei DMN URL to configure manually. `VERIFY: confirm the deployed processor URL in the target commercetools Connect project before configuring Nuvei.` |
| `RETURN_URL` | Optional | None | Fallback merchant return URL used when no return URL is available in request context. When set, it must be an HTTPS URL. `VERIFY: use the checkout return URL for the deployment environment.` |
| `CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS` | Optional in `connect.yaml` | Empty list | Comma-separated additional browser origins allowed to call the processor. Each configured origin must be HTTPS. `CTP_CHECKOUT_URL` is always included as an allowed origin. |
| `PORT` | Optional | `8080` | Port used by the Fastify processor service. The service listens on `0.0.0.0`. |
| `HEALTH_CHECK_TIMEOUT` | Optional | `5000` | Timeout in milliseconds used by the processor status checks. |
| `LOGGER_LEVEL` | Optional | `info` | Fastify and application logger level. |
| `CTP_CHECKOUT_APPLICATION_KEY` | Not used by current source | None | Present in the checked-in dotenv files, but no source file reads this variable. Keep only if your deployment tooling or external setup requires it. |
| `CTP_SCOPE` | Not used by current source | None | Present in the checked-in dotenv files, but no source file reads this variable. The required commercetools API scopes are documented in `connect.yaml` under `CTP_CLIENT_ID`. |

## Config file format

### Local dotenv files

The repository contains `.env` and `processor/.env`. The processor calls `dotenv.config()` without a custom path, so dotenv reads `.env` from the process current working directory.

Use this shape for local processor configuration; replace placeholders with real values and keep secrets out of source control:

```dotenv
CTP_PROJECT_KEY=your-project-key
CTP_AUTH_URL=https://auth.europe-west1.gcp.commercetools.com
CTP_API_URL=https://api.europe-west1.gcp.commercetools.com
CTP_SESSION_URL=https://session.europe-west1.gcp.commercetools.com
CTP_CHECKOUT_URL=https://checkout.europe-west1.gcp.commercetools.com
CTP_JWKS_URL=https://mc-api.europe-west1.gcp.commercetools.com/.well-known/jwks.json
CTP_JWT_ISSUER=https://mc-api.europe-west1.gcp.commercetools.com
CTP_CLIENT_ID=your-client-id
CTP_CLIENT_SECRET=your-client-secret

NUVEI_ENV=test
NUVEI_MERCHANT_ID=your-merchant-id
NUVEI_MERCHANT_SITE_ID=your-merchant-site-id
NUVEI_SECRET_KEY=your-secret-key
NUVEI_API_BASE_URL=https://sandbox.nuvei.com
NUVEI_DMN_CHECKSUM_ALGORITHM=sha256

CONNECT_SERVICE_URL=https://your-processor.example.com
RETURN_URL=https://your-checkout.example.com/return
CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS=https://your-checkout.example.com
PORT=8080
LOGGER_LEVEL=info
HEALTH_CHECK_TIMEOUT=5000
```

### commercetools Connect descriptor

`connect.yaml` defines two deployments:

```yaml
deployAs:
  - name: enabler
    applicationType: assets
  - name: processor
    applicationType: service
    endpoint: /
    configuration:
      standardConfiguration: []
      securedConfiguration: []
```

The processor `standardConfiguration` entries are non-secret settings such as commercetools endpoints, Nuvei environment, merchant IDs, API base URL, checksum algorithm, and CORS origins. The processor `securedConfiguration` entries are `CTP_CLIENT_ID`, `CTP_CLIENT_SECRET`, and `NUVEI_SECRET_KEY`.

`connect.yaml` also defines these processor lifecycle scripts:

```yaml
scripts:
  postDeploy: npm install && npm run connector:post-deploy
  preUndeploy: npm install && npm run connector:pre-undeploy
```

The post-deploy script prints the DMN webhook URL derived from `CONNECT_SERVICE_URL`; Nuvei dashboard registration remains a manual step. `VERIFY: confirm the final DMN URL in the Nuvei dashboard for each deployed environment.`

### Build and test configuration files

The following files configure the TypeScript, Vite, and Vitest toolchain rather than runtime behavior:

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `processor/tsconfig.json` | Builds processor TypeScript from `processor/src` to `processor/dist` with `NodeNext` modules and strict type checking. |
| `processor/vitest.config.ts` | Runs processor tests matching `test/**/*.test.ts` in a Node environment. |
| `enabler/tsconfig.json` | Builds enabler TypeScript declarations with DOM library types and strict type checking. |
| `enabler/vite.config.ts` | Builds the enabler library from `enabler/src/main.ts` into `enabler/public` as `connector-enabler.es.js` and `connector-enabler.umd.js`. |
| `enabler/vitest.config.ts` | Runs enabler tests matching `test/**/*.test.ts` in a Node environment. |

## Required vs optional settings

`processor/src/index.ts` calls `validateConfig()` before starting the Fastify server. Startup fails with `Missing required configuration: ...` when any of these values are empty or still set to the rejected `xxx` fallback:

- `CTP_CLIENT_ID`
- `CTP_CLIENT_SECRET`
- `NUVEI_MERCHANT_ID`
- `NUVEI_MERCHANT_SITE_ID`
- `NUVEI_SECRET_KEY`
- `NUVEI_API_BASE_URL`

The same validation includes these commercetools settings after applying source defaults. Absence of the corresponding environment variable does not by itself fail startup when a non-empty source default exists, but functional environments should set the real project values:

- `CTP_PROJECT_KEY`
- `CTP_AUTH_URL`
- `CTP_API_URL`
- `CTP_SESSION_URL`
- `CTP_CHECKOUT_URL`
- `CTP_JWKS_URL`
- `CTP_JWT_ISSUER`

URL validation fails when any configured value in this set is not HTTPS:

- `CTP_AUTH_URL`
- `CTP_API_URL`
- `CTP_SESSION_URL`
- `CTP_CHECKOUT_URL`
- `CTP_JWKS_URL`
- `CTP_JWT_ISSUER`
- `NUVEI_API_BASE_URL`
- `RETURN_URL`, when set
- every origin in `CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS`, when set

`NUVEI_DMN_CHECKSUM_ALGORITHM` fails validation with `NUVEI_DMN_CHECKSUM_ALGORITHM must be sha256` when it is set to any value other than `sha256`.

The following settings are optional for processor startup because source defaults or empty values are accepted:

- `NUVEI_ENV`
- `NUVEI_DMN_CHECKSUM_ALGORITHM`
- `CONNECT_SERVICE_URL`
- `RETURN_URL`
- `CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS`
- `PORT`
- `HEALTH_CHECK_TIMEOUT`
- `LOGGER_LEVEL`

## Defaults

Runtime defaults from `processor/src/config/config.ts` are:

| Setting | Default | Source behavior |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `CTP_PROJECT_KEY` | `payment-integration` | Used when the environment variable is absent. |
| `CTP_CLIENT_ID` | `xxx` | Rejected by `validateConfig()`. |
| `CTP_CLIENT_SECRET` | `xxx` | Rejected by `validateConfig()`. |
| `CTP_JWKS_URL` | `https://mc-api.europe-west1.gcp.commercetools.com/.well-known/jwks.json` | Must remain HTTPS. |
| `CTP_JWT_ISSUER` | `https://mc-api.europe-west1.gcp.commercetools.com` | Must remain HTTPS. |
| `CTP_AUTH_URL` | `https://auth.europe-west1.gcp.commercetools.com` | Must remain HTTPS. |
| `CTP_API_URL` | `https://api.europe-west1.gcp.commercetools.com` | Must remain HTTPS. |
| `CTP_SESSION_URL` | `https://session.europe-west1.gcp.commercetools.com/` | Must remain HTTPS. |
| `CTP_CHECKOUT_URL` | `https://checkout.europe-west1.gcp.commercetools.com` | Must remain HTTPS and is included in the allowed CORS origins. |
| `HEALTH_CHECK_TIMEOUT` | `5000` | Parsed with `parseInt`. |
| `LOGGER_LEVEL` | `info` | Passed to Fastify logger configuration. |
| `NUVEI_ENV` | `test` | Returned by the processor config endpoint. |
| `NUVEI_DMN_CHECKSUM_ALGORITHM` | `sha256` | Hard-coded as `sha256` in the runtime config object. |
| `CONNECT_SERVICE_URL` | Empty string | Used only by the post-deploy script for printing the DMN URL. |
| `PORT` | `8080` | Parsed with `parseInt`. |
| `RETURN_URL` | Empty string | Used only when no merchant return URL is present in request context. |
| `CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS` | Empty list | Split on commas, trimmed, and empty entries removed. The Merchant Center origin derived from `CTP_JWT_ISSUER` and the configured Checkout URL are always allowed. |

The Nuvei client has one additional internal default: request timeout is `10000` milliseconds when no timeout is passed to `NuveiClient`. The production singleton in `processor/src/clients/nuvei.client.ts` does not pass a timeout override.

## Per-environment overrides

No `.env.development`, `.env.test`, or `.env.production` files are present in the repository. The application does not switch configuration files based on `NODE_ENV`; it uses whatever environment variables are present in the process environment and the dotenv file loaded from the current working directory.

Recommended local workflow:

1. Keep local processor values in `processor/.env`.
2. Start the processor from the package directory:

```bash
cd processor
npm run dev
```

3. Use HTTPS URLs for every configured external endpoint, return URL, and CORS origin. Local plain-host values such as `payments.localhost` do not satisfy runtime URL validation.

For commercetools Connect deployments, configure environment-specific values through `connect.yaml` standard and secured configuration inputs. Secrets belong in secured configuration. `VERIFY: confirm the exact production commercetools region, Nuvei account, processor public URL, return URL, and allowed checkout origins with the deployment owner before promoting configuration between environments.`
